questions.name: sgE-7355140-1-101
questions.question: The car behind you begins to pass you. You should:

options.text: Maintain your speed so traffic will flow smoothly
Pull to the right and stop so he can pass
Slow down slightly and stay in your lane
Blow your horn to allow him to pass

questions.answer_text: Slow down slightly and stay in your lane

questions.name: sgE-7355140-1-97
questions.question: After you have passed a car you should return to the right lane when you:

options.text: See the front bumper of the other car in your mirror
Have put your turn signal on
Have turned your headlights on
See the other car's headlights come on

questions.answer_text: See the front bumper of the other car in your mirror

questions.name: sgE-7355140-1-100
questions.question: When you want to overtake and pass another vehicle you should:

options.text: Wait for a signal from the other driver
Change lanes quickly so the other driver will see you
Signal and pass when safe to do so
Stay close behind so you need less time to pass

questions.answer_text: Signal and pass when safe to do so

questions.name: sgE-7355140-1-96
questions.question: You are driving in the middle lane on a three lane expressway. A car begins to pass you on the right. The actions of that driver are:

options.text: Wrong because "pass on the left" is a firm rule
Wrong because he's passing you in your "blind spot"
OK as long as he does it on a limited access highway
OK if no signs forbid passing on the right

questions.answer_text: OK if no signs forbid passing on the right

questions.name: sgE-7355140-1-103
questions.question: What does it mean when a school bus is stopped and its red lights are flashing?

options.text: You may pass if no children are on the road
You may not pass while the red lights are flashing
You may pass if you are facing the front of the bus
You may pass if it is on the other side of a divided highway

questions.answer_text: You may not pass while the red lights are flashing

questions.name: sgE-7355140-1-102
questions.question: You may pass another vehicle on the right if it is waiting to:

options.text: Turn right
Turn left
Park at the curb
Turn into a driveway on the right

questions.name: sgE-7355140-1-99
questions.question: In general, you should pass vehicles going in the same direction you are going:

options.text: On the right
On the left
Only if the other driver signals it is safe
Whenever you have the opportunity to do so

questions.name: sgE-7355140-1-98
questions.question: In which of the following situations is passing always forbidden?

options.text: The vehicle ahead is making a left turn
You are on a one-way street which has two lanes
The vehicle ahead is stopped for a pedestrian in a crosswalk
The vehicle ahead is going to park parallel to the curb

questions.answer_text: The vehicle ahead is stopped for a pedestrian in a crosswalk
